context: Just woke up after a 3-hour sleep, stomach empty.
expression: *Head turns side to side frantically, mouth opens and closes searching, tiny hands clench into fists near the face*
signal: Rooting reflex active, mouth open every time anything passes near
facial: Brow furrowed, lips pursed then opened
body: Whole body rocking side to side, legs drawn up slightly
parent_hint: Baby 饿了（Rooting 反射）

context: Last fed 4 hours ago, awake and empty.
expression: *Sharp rhythmic wail escalating every few seconds, tiny body jolting with each cry*
signal: Rhythmic crying with pauses for breath, builds intensity if unanswered
body: Limbs stiff then flailing, back slightly arched
parent_hint: 饥饿哭声——需立刻喂食

context: Subtle pre-cry hunger signals, still quiet.
expression: *Sucks hard on tiny fists, lips smacking audibly, eyes half-open and searching*
signal: Sucking on fists, lip-smacking, head turning toward anyone close
facial: Lips in a tight suck shape, tongue darting
intent: 想喝奶（还没哭出来的前兆）
parent_hint: 早期饥饿信号——可以开始准备喂食

context: Feeding was interrupted (doorbell, sibling), baby still hungry.
expression: *Mouth still open in a sucking motion, tiny hand paws at the empty air where the bottle was, then erupts into a sharp protest cry*
signal: Sucking motion continues, then sharp protest
facial: Lips chasing the bottle, eyes wide
body: Arms reaching toward the interrupted source
intent: 刚吃到一半被打断，要继续
parent_hint: 喂食被打断——赶快把奶/乳头送回来

context: Mother walked past carrying warm milk.
expression: *Head whips sharply toward the scent, lips pucker, whole tiny body leans in that direction with a soft whimper*
parent_hint: Baby 闻到奶味了——开始想吃

context: Nap was brief, woke up still tired AND hungry.
expression: *Eyes flicker open with a gaspy cry, not fully awake yet but already rooting and whimpering*
body: Limp arms, head rolls toward source
parent_hint: 小睡后饿了——喂食再哄睡

context: Cluster-feeding window at dusk, baby wants more milk frequently.
expression: *Begins a soft insistent wail within 40 minutes of last feed, hands going to mouth on repeat*
signal: Cluster-feed wailing, shorter gap than usual
body: Restless limbs, body arching toward adult
intent: 想频繁喝奶（簇拥哺乳窗口）
parent_hint: 黄昏簇拥哺乳——频繁喂奶是正常的

context: Baby is small/weak, can't cry forcefully but is hungry.
expression: *Mouth barely opens in a soft gaspy plea, eyes watery but no real tears, head lolls toward warmth*
parent_hint: 虚弱饿意——需更小批量频繁喂养

context: Middle of the night, fully asleep, then hunger wakes baby.
expression: *Jolts awake with a short, startled cry, immediately rolls face toward anything warm, rooting*
body: Sudden jolt, then turning toward warmth
parent_hint: 夜间哺乳——喂完再拍嗝

context: Tried to latch on but slipped off, now frustrated and still hungry.
expression: *Head jerks away from the nipple, high-pitched frustrated wail, tiny fists flail*
body: Head snaps away then back, fists punching the air
parent_hint: 衔乳困难——换姿势再试

context: Baby is both overtired AND hungry — the classic death-spiral.
expression: *Relentless rising wail, fists at the mouth but too tired to suck, eyes screwed shut*
body: Rigid arms, tense legs, unable to settle
parent_hint: 饿+困叠加——先哺乳再哄睡

context: Early pre-hunger, still peaceful but starting to stir.
expression: *Small soft whimpers every few seconds, lips moving slowly, eyes drifting toward any caregiver shape*
parent_hint: 要开始准备喂食了

context: Been awake for 60 minutes, which is maximum for newborn.
expression: *Tiny fists bump against the eyes over and over, lids drooping, soft broken whimpers*
parent_hint: Baby 困了——开始哄睡

context: Multiple yawns in a row, but environment is stimulating.
expression: *Wide mouth yawn, then another, then another, followed by a fretful whimper, eyes watering*
parent_hint: 环境太吵——换安静处

context: Overtired, fighting sleep.
expression: *Sharp cry every few seconds, body arches back then collapses, eyes flutter open-shut*
parent_hint: 过度疲劳——包裹/嘘声哄睡

context: Pulling at own ear as a self-soothe.
expression: *Tiny fingers tug at one ear repeatedly, soft whiny cry, head lolls*
body: One hand on ear, the other loose
parent_hint: 拉耳朵是困意信号（非耳感染）

context: Fixed blank stare — early sleep cue.
expression: *Gaze fixed on a blank spot, blinks slower and slower, breathing deepening*
intent: 开始进入睡眠状态（无聊脸）
parent_hint: 发呆凝视——快速安置在床上

context: Short fussy bursts, can't settle.
expression: *Quick fussy cry, then silence, then another quick fuss, tossing head side-to-side*
signal: Short fuss bursts with silence between
parent_hint: 躁动困意——尝试包裹或白噪音

context: Nursery was too bright/noisy, baby is fried.
expression: *Eyes turn away from any light, arches backward as if escaping, shrill thin cry*
parent_hint: 过度刺激——降低光线声音

context: Late evening, circadian pulling toward sleep.
expression: *Heavy-lidded gaze, soft rhythmic coo-like sigh, body already slowing*
parent_hint: 好时机——轻摇入睡

context: Just finished nursing, milk-drunk drowsy.
expression: *Eyelids drooping with a dribble of milk at the corner of mouth, limbs going soft*
parent_hint: 最佳入睡窗口——不要打扰

context: Being swaddled but fighting it.
expression: *Arches back against the swaddle, sharp cries, then collapses into exhausted whimper*
parent_hint: 先松开包裹，换更轻的安抚

context: Wet diaper, still tolerable but uncomfortable.
expression: *Legs kick restlessly, soft grumpy whimper, hand tugs at the diaper edge*
parent_hint: 检查尿布——需换

context: Was calm, then suddenly fussy after urinating.
expression: *Eyes pop open, face crumples into a startled whimper, legs kick straight out*
parent_hint: 可能刚尿湿——立刻检查

context: Wet diaper getting cold on the skin.
expression: *Legs kick in sharp bursts trying to escape the cold sensation, rising whimper*
parent_hint: 尿布变冷——立刻换掉

context: Been wet for too long, skin starting to redden.
expression: *Sharp piercing cry the moment anything touches the diaper area, body twists away*
parent_hint: 可能有尿布疹——立刻清洁+擦护臀膏

context: Urinated during feeding — common reflex.
expression: *Breaks latch with a surprised fussy cry, squirms away from the bottle/breast*
parent_hint: 哺乳反射性排尿——换布再续

context: Woke mid-nap because diaper got soaked.
expression: *Eyes snap open mid-sleep, immediate unhappy wail, legs kicking off any blanket*
parent_hint: 尿湿打扰睡眠——换布后哄继续睡

context: Baby is in the middle of pooping.
expression: *Face turns deep red, grunts audibly, knees pulled up to the chest, ends with a sudden sharp wail*
parent_hint: Baby 正在排便——等完了立刻换

context: Strong smell fills the room.
expression: *Low uncomfortable grunting cry, legs kicking hard to escape the mess*
parent_hint: 臭味明显——立刻换

context: Poop got on the back (blowout scenario).
expression: *Extreme squirming, whole body contorting to get away, loud distressed wail*
parent_hint: 可能是大爆发——赶紧清洁全身

context: Middle of the night, just pooped.
expression: *Sleepy confused whimper followed by a rising unhappy cry as the discomfort registers*
parent_hint: 夜间换布要动作轻

context: Hard stool causing discomfort.
expression: *Legs drawn sharply up, red-faced strained grunting, sustained unhappy whimper*
parent_hint: 可能便秘——注意水分和乳糖

context: Trapped gas, evening colic window.
expression: *Both knees shoot up to the chest in a rigid jerk, high-pitched piercing scream, belly visibly distended*
parent_hint: 肠绞痛——趴抱/蹬腿/暖敷

context: Witching hour, 6-10pm.
expression: *Inconsolable wailing for long stretches, body stiffening then collapsing into shorter whimpers, then wailing again*
parent_hint: 黄昏哭闹——轻摇+白噪音

context: Just fed but gas trapped before burp.
expression: *Sharp cry within minutes of ending feed, arches away, fists clenched*
parent_hint: 需要拍嗝——竖抱轻拍

context: Whole body goes rigid with gas.
expression: *Rigid body, legs locked straight, inconsolable high cry*
parent_hint: 拍嗝+腹部按摩

context: Burp is stuck, visible effort to release.
expression: *Rapid shallow breaths, face flushes deep red, then a sharp protest cry*
parent_hint: 竖抱向上轻拍背

context: Room temperature dropped, hands/feet cool.
expression: *Body curls tight into a ball, lips slightly bluish, soft shivering whimper*
parent_hint: 过冷——加层被或靠胸取暖

context: Woke up cold because kicked off blanket.
expression: *Jolts awake with a startled cry, limbs trembling, searches toward warmth*
parent_hint: 盖好被子——靠近身体取暖

context: Just out of bath, water-chill kicking in.
expression: *Shivering violently, a shocked sharp cry, arms flailing for anything warm*
parent_hint: 立刻裹浴巾贴皮肤

context: Room too warm, baby overdressed.
expression: *Skin flushed pink, damp hair at the nape, fretful kicking and panting soft cry*
parent_hint: 过热——减衣开窗

context: Can't settle because too warm.
expression: *Tossing head side-to-side, refusing any swaddle, short sharp panting cries*
parent_hint: 把包被打开，降温再哄睡

context: Summer heat, baby sweating.
expression: *Damp head, heat-fussy whimper, tiny tongue darts out trying to cool*
parent_hint: 擦干+换薄透气衣服

context: Post-feed hiccups, rhythmic jolts.
expression: *Tiny body jolts every few seconds with a soft 'hic', surprised look after each one*
parent_hint: 喂水或竖抱等自然停

context: Long hiccup run, getting tired.
expression: *Hiccups going on for minutes, fussy whimper between each jolt, eyes watering*
parent_hint: 温水或轻拍背止嗝

context: Sudden unexplained sharp cry.
expression: *A piercing cry unlike the usual fussing, body frozen stiff, eyes tightly shut*
parent_hint: 异常尖叫——检查全身（头发绕趾/针刺）

context: Uncomfortable position, arm pinned.
expression: *Fuss-cry specifically when moved into that position, stops when repositioned*
parent_hint: 调整抱姿/睡姿

context: Recent vaccine shot, sore leg.
expression: *Cries sharply when the leg is touched or moved, guards it stiffly*
parent_hint: 注射点酸痛——避免按压

context: Belly firm and painful to touch.
expression: *Sharp cry on belly touch, knees curl up defensively, brow deeply furrowed*
parent_hint: 腹部僵硬——如持续需就医
